blockingIssues.problem: Overgeneralization: the idea's title and rationale state a general lesson about generic editorial-hierarchy rules (“can backfire” and that this affects whether prompt edits can be safely rolled into production) without limiting that claim to the specific prompt, model, workflow, and dataset tested in Experiment 005. The source explicitly limits generality (see Limitations) and reports a single controlled comparison of one prompt change in one system.
blockingIssues.correction: Narrow the claim to the documented experiment and scope. For example, change the title to: “Experiment 005 — In this prompt/agent context, adding a generic ‘Preserve Editorial Intent’ section shifted emphasis and introduced unsupported claims.” Revise the rationale to say: “In this experiment and configuration, the broadly-worded editorial rule altered emphasis and introduced unsupported assertions; teams should validate similar edits in their own systems before promoting them.”
